motion.name: hero-lines
motion.purpose: First-paint CSS entrance: y 36 to 0, opacity 0.68 to 1, 120ms second-line delay, shared easing. Hydration never restarts it.

motion.name: hero-copy
motion.purpose: CSS entrance: y 18 to 0, opacity 0.9 to 1; role/subtitle/description/actions delays 300/380/460/540ms.

motion.name: product-settle
motion.purpose: Whole evidence frame; scoped GSAP ScrollTrigger, top 95% to center 55%, scrub 0.6s. Native page scrolling stays intact.

motion.name: word-emphasis
motion.purpose: GSAP heading-triggered progression, top 95% to top 35%, stagger 0.12s, scrub 0.6s. Reduced motion renders full-opacity, untransformed content.

motion.name: disclosure-panel
motion.purpose: Shared Web Animations API controller; measured height in flow, opacity/transform for floating panels. Interruptible from the current frame, inert on exit, resize-aware, refreshes subsequent scroll effects after completion. Native fallback without JavaScript or with reduced motion.

motion.name: anchor-scroll
motion.value: native smooth for pointer-activated same-page anchors / immediate for direct URLs, keyboard and reduced motion
motion.purpose: Pointer activation opts into native smooth scrolling. Keyboard input and media cleanup remove the opt-in so initial fragments land without an interrupted entrance. Visible keyboard focus and reduced motion override ScrollTrigger’s inline scroll-behavior restoration.

narrative.overview:
The approved direction combines wide personal typography, ivory reading surfaces, ink text and cobalt actions. Outfit carries both identity and practical reading. Open rows, shared alignment and actual product captures give the work its presence; the interface stays precise and personal.

The system uses tonal chapters, restrained framing and purposeful motion. Experience is inverse ink; approach uses a cobalt field. These chapters share the same type, spacing, actions, disclosures and focus language. The source of visual truth is `src/index.css`, the sections composed by `src/App.tsx`, and `src/hooks/usePortfolioMotion.ts`. The surface composition and approved direction remain in `docs/portfolio-direction.md`.
keyCharacteristics: One self-hosted Outfit family across display, content and controls.
Shared gutters and an open twelve-column spatial model.
Real evidence framed with restrained depth.
Cobalt actions and coherent inverse chapters.
Readable baseline content, native disclosures and optional motion.

rules.name: The Shared Palette Rule
rules.body: Keep semantic colors consistent across sections; product imagery retains its own authentic colors without recoloring shared controls.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Extend the hierarchy with Outfit and the established roles; keep readable line breaks and the existing language parity.

rules.name: The Evidence Depth Rule
rules.body: Use depth for floating navigation, contextual panels and real evidence; preserve open reading rows for ordinary content.

dos: **Do** reuse the shared palette, container, type roles, action styles and focus treatment.
**Do** keep product captures authentic, dimensioned and meaningful in both languages.
**Do** keep reading order, section destinations and functional links intact at every breakpoint.
**Do** preserve native disclosure behavior, keyboard operation, visible focus and status feedback.
**Do** keep content readable before motion and respect reduced motion, forced colors and no-JavaScript reading.
donts: **Don't** restore the superseded serif dossier or its vermilion accent.
**Don't** introduce a separate visual identity or control palette per section or product.
**Don't** replace real product evidence with simulated screenshots, decorative device chrome or invented metrics.
**Don't** turn ordinary content into walls of cards or capability names into anonymous badge decoration.
**Don't** hide essential content behind animation or run native and GSAP scroll effects on the same element.
